draft.subject: Getting Ridge Ventures' first project started
draft.body:
Hi Lin,

Thanks again for flagging the notification badge issue — Tariq let you know that one's been taken care of, so hopefully things are quieter now.

Since then I haven't wanted to leave you stranded on setup. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one project in place usually makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project if you'd like to try it yourself.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything else.

Best,
Chidi
